queries: WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio FROM event AS e LEFT JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.type) SELECT event_type, avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio, ABS(avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio - AVG(avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio) OVER ()) AS distance_from_mean_of_type_averages FROM per_type ORDER BY event_type;

WITH per_type AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.type) SELECT event_type, avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio, ABS(avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio - AVG(avg_spent_to_budgeted_ratio) OVER ()) AS distance_from_mean_of_type_averages FROM per_type ORDER BY event_type;

WITH type_averages AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.type) SELECT event_type, average_ratio, ABS(average_ratio - (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) FROM type_averages)) AS distance_from_mean FROM type_averages ORDER BY event_type;
